d53: Everton once called Anfield home. The club was formed in 1878, and moved to Anfield in 1884. But in 1892, a dispute with the ground’s owner changed the city’s football story. Everton moved across Stanley Park to Goodison. Liverpool was formed to play at the empty Anfield. Before the derby had a scoreline, it had a shared address.
